recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white triple-exposure portrait of a woman, capturing a spectrum of emotion from an aggressive scream on the left to a neutral gaze in the center and a somber, downward look on the right. The faces overlap with varying levels of transparency against a solid black void.
coreVisualRelationships: The screaming face acts as the primary emotional anchor with the highest local contrast.
Overlapping facial features create a ghosting effect that suggests movement or internal conflict.
The transition from high-energy expression to low-energy expression moves from left to right.
coreInvariants: High-key highlights on skin and teeth
Consistent lighting direction across all exposures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally but weighted emotionally to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The open mouth and teeth of the leftmost exposure provide the sharpest point of focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows a horizontal arc across the three sets of eyes, moving from the intense squint on the left to the closed lids on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the frame is entirely negative space, emphasizing the isolation of the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black serves as the negative space and shadow depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white highlights define the contours of the face, hair edges, and jewelry.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays provide the texture for skin and the translucent overlap areas.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from 0 to 100 to create a dramatic, silver-gelatin look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with three distinct expressions (angry, neutral, sad) layered over each other using a multiple exposure technique against a black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a stark, minimalist sans-serif in white, placed in the upper negative space to maintain the focus on the facial expressions.

verificationChecks: Ensure the teeth and eyes are the brightest points.
Check that the overlaps do not muddy the facial features excessively.
Verify the background is absolute black.

adjustableVariables: Amount of hair detail visible against the black
mustRedesign: Ensure the jewelry (necklace) aligns or creates a rhythmic pattern across the exposures

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the primary expression
Smooth gradients in the skin tones

postGenerationChecks: Are there exactly three distinct facial positions?
Is the leftmost face the most expressive?
Is the lighting consistent across all three exposures?
Does the image feel like a single cohesive moment rather than three separate photos?
recipe.reuseFormula: Triple-exposure monochrome portrait + high-contrast lighting + black void background + emotional progression (left-to-right).
